name: minions-bundles-agency-workspace
description: Full-stack IT agency bundle — prospecting, outreach, CRM pipeline, delivery, billing, and client management for productized service businesses
author: Mehdi Nabhani <mehdi@the-mehdi.com> (https://the-mehdi.com)

scripts.build: pnpm --filter @minions-bundles-agency/sdk run build && pnpm --filter @minions-bundles-agency/cli run build && pnpm --filter minions-bundles-agency-docs run build && pnpm --filter minions-bundles-agency-blog run build && pnpm --filter minions-bundles-agency-web run build
scripts.deploy:blog: pnpm --filter minions-bundles-agency-blog run build && netlify deploy --dir apps/blog/dist --prod
scripts.deploy:docs: pnpm --filter minions-bundles-agency-docs run build && netlify deploy --dir apps/docs/dist --prod
scripts.deploy:web: pnpm --filter minions-bundles-agency-web run build && netlify deploy --dir apps/web/dist --prod
scripts.lint: pnpm --filter @minions-bundles-agency/sdk run build && pnpm --filter @minions-bundles-agency/sdk run lint && pnpm --filter @minions-bundles-agency/cli run lint
